name: late_unlocks
description: Day 300 with every Act 1 nav panel open, if unlocked (Conditional Logic completed) and 1.1 to 1.5 and 1.c done (A Voice active), a first retirement behind it, a Research Lab built (the lab's research shows, the Blueprint Archive completed, so the Blueprints are bought). Program 1 loads the pads once their cargo is picked (they start with No cargo; paid first) and tries Buy Titanium on 10 credits (runs at half on day 1, then fails); the Solar Panels can't cover every upkeep, so the last buildings run partial.
